articles.title: Middle East war helps lift Reliance’s oil-to-chemicals earnings to an all-time high
articles.titleEn: Middle East war helps lift Reliance’s oil-to-chemicals earnings to an all-time high
articles.summary: Reliance Industries' oil-to-chemicals sector reported record earnings due to soaring global fuel prices. The firm credited this success to the rise in energy costs and improved refining margins for the second quarter. While rising crude oil and transport fuel prices bolstered revenue, increased procurement and transportation expenses served as a constraint on overall earnings.

articles.title: Global Commodity Shock: World Bank Warns of Rising Food, Fuel Prices and Economic Turmoil
articles.titleEn: Global Commodity Shock: World Bank Warns of Rising Food, Fuel Prices and Economic Turmoil
articles.summary: The World Bank warns that global commodity prices could rise 23% in 2026, driven by energy disruptions, food shortages, geopolitical conflicts and extreme weather, increasing costs for businesses and consumers. Developing countries face growing inflation and economic risks, making stronger supply chains, targeted consumer protection and coordinated government policies essential for economic stability.

articles.title: Indonesia looks to India & China for fuel supplies
articles.titleEn: Indonesia looks to India & China for fuel supplies
articles.summary: Indonesia is exploring gasoline imports from India and China to combat rising global crude oil prices. The country's energy minister Bahlil Lahadalia will visit India this week for discussions. Indonesia has faced significant fuel supply disruptions in various provinces due to increased demand and distribution challenges. President Prabowo has directed the exploration of alternative energy sources amidst geopolitical tensions. The situation underscores Indonesia's urgent need for reliable energy supply solutions.

articles.title: 'A Crisis on 4 Fronts': Jaishankar Blasts Developed & Rich Nations as '4F Crisis' Explodes | Vantage
articles.titleEn: 'A Crisis on 4 Fronts': Jaishankar Blasts Developed & Rich Nations as '4F Crisis' Explodes | Vantage
articles.summary: Global conflicts are driving a chain reaction across food, fuel, fertiliser and finance, with the economic fallout reaching countries far beyond the battlefields. In this video, Firstpost examines External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar’s warning about the growing '4F crisis' and how disruptions to energy supplies and shipping routes are pushing up costs across the global economy. The video explores how rising oil and gas prices affect fertiliser production, how conflict and extreme weather are adding to food inflation, and why import-dependent countries face mounting financial pressure. It also examines Jaishankar’s call for greater international cooperation, diversified sources of essential goods and more resilient supply chains to protect vulnerable economies. Hem Saroya tells you more.

articles.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio highlighted India's significant energy requirements while discussing waived sanctions on Russia. These sanctions, part of the Lindsey O. Graham Act, could have imposed tariffs on countries importing Russian fuel. Rubio mentioned a 60-day period for further analysis of the sanctions' impact on the global economy. Additionally, he noted changing geopolitical situations affecting global energy supplies and prices.
